name: xArm 6 model
summary: The UFACTORY xArm 6 for the digital twin: kinematics and 3D meshes (UFACTORY's own, BSD-3), for the twin view and the simulated camera.
help: Downloads UFACTORY's meshes of the xArm 6 (github.com/xArm-Developer/xarm_ros, BSD-3-Clause, Copyright UFACTORY Inc.) once into the worker's data folder (cache/xarm6), merges details smaller than Detail, and writes xarm6.robot.json.gz (about 220 KB: joints, limits, meshes in mm) with the license. Connect it to the xArm twin view and to Simulate games / Tic-tac-toe game (Robot model input), which draw the arm in the simulated camera. The machine needs to reach raw.githubusercontent.com the first time.

params.label: Detail (mm)
params.help: Details smaller than this merge: 3 mm looks like the arm and stays small
